$comment: Where a docs page may say 'simulated' (DG.4, #1322). yarn check:loop-wording fails on any other occurrence, and on an entry here that no longer matches. Each entry is a phrase, the pages it may appear on, and why it is true. Adding one is a reviewed diff: the loop runs for real, so 'simulated' may only name the run simulator (a test tool), the data origin it stamps, or a feature that really does simulate.
